name: Classic 2-step shuffle
desc: Textbook UKG 2-step: 909 kick on the one plus the skip, snare on 2 and 4 with rim ghost swaps, 707 hats pushed late for shuffle, open-hat euclid slowly rotating its offset. Snare fills bloom at 4-bar phrase ends.

rate.doc: pattern rate multiplier, bare JS arg

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] <~ [~ ~ ~ bd]>").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.25).gain(${gain}), s("~ sd ~ <sd sd sd [sd ~ ~ rim]>").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.8).room(${room}), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.5 .25 .4 .28]*2").late("[0 .022]*4").lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.5, ${hatcut}).slow(32)), s("oh(2,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.28).cut(1)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ [~ bd] [~ ~ bd ~]").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.82).room(${room}).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("[hh hh hh <hh [hh hh]>]*2").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.55 .3 .45 .3]*2").late("[0 .02]*4").lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.6, ${hatcut}*1.2).slow(16)), s("oh(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.3).cut(1), s("rim(3,16,<0 4 8 12>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.35)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
